integrity: The theorem is proved by induction; finite checking corroborates but does not replace proof. Priority against other terminology is not exhaustively established.
scientific_limitations: Only Cartesian products of simple cycles of length at least four.
The extremal size bound and existence of a two-layer optimizer were previously known; the additional assertion is exact classification and enumeration of all equality cases.
No polynomial counting all convex subsets or classification of near-optima is claimed.
title: Extremal two-neighbor nonpercolation is rigid on multidimensional cycle tori
